title: Adi Dassler, a Divided Factory and a Handwritten 'i' in 1949
conflicts: Staff split: Dassler foundation says about two-thirds stayed with Adi; dpa (Abendzeitung 2019) says 47 stayed and 13 went to Rudolf; story says 'most of the staff' and uses 47 only as Adi's 1949 starting headcount (adidas and dpa agree). Age: adidas says 49, but his 3 November 1900 birth date makes him 48 on 18 August 1949; story says 48. Joint firm founded 1919 (Business Insider) or registered 1924 (adidas, dpa); story says 'more than twenty years'. Causes of the split are disputed; story gives the documented strands without choosing between them.
notes: Quote is Gunn's maxim 26 (stance complicates): set out after a quarrel, then make peace; Adi did the first, never the second. The adidassler.org foundation is run by Adi's family; its Nazi-era account is used only for the documented tribunal classifications and the February 1947 letter. Fortune's bomb-shelter anecdote omitted as legend.
